evidence.quote: The deal underscores a broader ‌shift as tech giants increasingly tap debt and equity markets to fund AI infrastructure, with ​spending set to top $700 billion this year.
On Sunday, the Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia (NVDA) is in talks to guarantee $250 billion in financing that would allow OpenAI to lease a data center being built in Ohio.
The Ohio facility could cost over $500 billion and would be the largest data-center project announced to date, according to the Journal.
Additionally, OpenAI has committed $300 billion to Oracle (ORCL) to secure data-center capacity, much of which Oracle will use to buy Nvidia GPUs.
